messages:
carmen: quick follow-up from the 03:30am page surge — want a short sprint to knock down the noise vectors we saw. proposed owners + fast timelines: 
- bump noisy infra/cpu rule + 24h staging dry-run (owner: ty) target: 72h
- add dedupe by job+error signature for api-errors (owner: lee) target: 5d
- suppression rule for short-lived flappers + audit list (owner: carmen) target: 10d
- create CI smoke that triggers synthetic alerts to validate dedupe/suppression (owner: lee) target: 7d
can owners ack and call out any blockers? tagging @ops-bot to create tracker :clipboard:

ty: acked. i'll take cpu rule bump. i'll increase threshold to 0.92 and add `for: 2m` stabilization in staging for a 24h dry-run. will paste rule diff and grafana link when ready.

lee: taking dedupe + CI smoke. plan: dedupe_key: `{{ job }}:{{ error_sig }}` and a CI job that emits 10 synthetic 5xxs to ensure we don't lose unique errors. PR by Wed.

carmen: for suppression, thinking of `flap_count > 3 in 10m` metric suppression and forward suppressed alerts to `#suppression-review`. will exclude control-plane hosts. need list of those hosts, i'll DM infra-sre.

ops-bot: Task created: https://tasks.company/INFR-6789 "Noise mitigation sprint: cpu bump, dedupe, suppression, smoke tests" assigned to [ty, lee, carmen] due 2026-04-05 :white_check_mark:

lee: quick question on dedupe: do we want to keep an exception for auth-errors that include user-specific IDs? i.e., preserve uniqueness if `user_id` present.

carmen: yes - add a rule: if `user_id` tag exists then append `:{{ user_id }}` to the dedupe key. avoids hiding user-facing regressions.

ty: pasted rule diff i'll test in staging tomorrow AM:
```
# old
expr: avg by(instance)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[5m])) > 0.85
# proposed
expr: avg by(instance)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[5m])) > 0.92
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: medium
```
will watch the dry-run dashboard and roll back if we see missed capacity.

lee: noted on user_id exception, will add to template. CI smoke will validate both dedupe and exception logic.

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run monitoring check in 24h (1823537634).

carmen: thanks all. i'll fold these into the postmortem action table and close the task once smoke tests pass. final checklist: ty (72h), lee (5-7d), carmen (10d). flag here if you need more time. :thumbsup:
